artifacts.page_copy:
# London AI x Climate Meetup

Three lightning talks, one panel, and a room full of people who want AI to do something useful for the planet.

**When:** Thursday 12 November, 18:30 to 21:30
**Where:** Campus Hub Shoreditch, London

Expect short, practical talks on grid forecasting, supply chain carbon accounting and satellite methane detection, then food, drinks and plenty of time to talk. Free to attend, limited to 60 people.

artifacts.newsletter_html:
London AI x Climate Meetup

Join us on Thursday 12 November at Campus Hub Shoreditch for three lightning talks and a panel on applied AI for climate.

  • Grid forecasting with ML
  • Carbon accounting for supply chains
  • Satellite data for methane detection

Food and drinks provided. Free, 60 spots.

Reserve your place

artifacts.whatsapp: Hey all! London AI x Climate meetup is on Thu 12 Nov, 18:30 at Campus Hub Shoreditch. 3 lightning talks + food and drinks, free. Grab a spot: https://lu.ma/ai-climate-london

memories_used.text: Campus Hub Shoreditch hosted 55 people comfortably; evening hire was 350 GBP and AV was on site.
Vegetarian-led finger food ran about 9.50 GBP per head and nothing was left over.
Two drinks per head was enough; start registration 30 minutes before talks to avoid a queue.
